items.title: Google Discover Core Update Causes Local Publishers to Lose National Reach
items.summary: New third-party data from DiscoverSnoop and NewzDash shows that local publishers suffered significant losses in national reach following Google's February 2026 Discover core update. While some national publishers gained visibility, many local news outlets saw sharp declines. This update underscores the challenges for niche publishers in Google's evolving recommendation system.<grok:render type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">1</argument></grok:render><grok:render type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">2</argument></grok:render>

items.title: Breaking News Traffic Surges 103% Despite AI Overviews Slashing Publisher Clicks
items.summary: AI Overviews have reduced publisher traffic from Google search by 42%, but breaking news content is thriving with a 103% increase in traffic. Discover clicks are also surging for timely stories, benefiting publishers with fast operations. Evergreen content suffers most in this shift.<grok:render type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">0</argument></grok:render><grok:render type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">6</argument></grok:render>

items.title: Over The Top SEO Launches Dedicated Generative Engine Optimization Division
items.summary: Over The Top SEO has become one of the first agencies to offer a full-service Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) division amid rising AI search demands. This specializes in optimizing for AI-generated results beyond traditional SEO. The launch signals the mainstream adoption of AI search strategies.<grok:render type="render_inline_citation"><argument name="citation_id">5</argument></grok:render>

items.title: CrowdReply Hits $5M ARR and Launches 2.0 for AI Answer Rankings
items.summary: Bootstrapped CrowdReply reached $5M ARR and unveiled version 2.0, positioning it as the benchmark for ranking in AI-generated answers. The tool helps content appear in AI search responses. A viral post outlines using it to build GEO agencies for local businesses.

items.title: SEO Evolves into GEO: Becoming Part of AI-Generated Answers
items.summary: Full Stack Marketer Tomas Corza details the shift from traditional SEO to Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), where AI synthesizes answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI. Success requires structured, authoritative content that AI can cite directly. Optimizing only for SERPs leaves brands invisible in no-click searches.

items.title: AEO and GEO: Surviving 70% No-Click AI Searches in 2026
items.summary: After traditional SEO failed against ChatGPT, TendoRonin shares practical AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and GEO tactics for AI visibility, including evolved backlinks. With 60-70% of searches ending without clicks due to AI Overviews, products need to be cited or recommended by AI. This deep dive targets discoverability for SaaS and ecom.

items.title: Grammarly Removes AI 'Expert Review' Feature After Backlash and Lawsuit
items.summary: Grammarly discontinued its AI 'Expert Review' feature that mimicked editing styles of well-known authors, including some deceased, without permission. The decision follows public backlash and a class-action lawsuit by journalist Julia Angwin over unauthorized use of her name. Critics highlighted ethical issues in AI tools impersonating human experts in writing and editing.

items.title: Nearly 10,000 Authors Publish Empty Book to Protest AI Data Training
items.summary: Almost 10,000 authors released an empty book titled 'None of the Above' to sabotage AI training datasets using their works without consent. The protest targets companies scraping books for AI models, flooding systems with valueless content. It underscores tensions between authors and AI firms over copyright in publishing.

items.title: Official BookTok Chart Launches in the UK
items.summary: The UK has launched its first official BookTok chart, tracking viral books from TikTok, following successful trials in Germany. Media Control compiles the data to reflect BookTok's sales influence. Publishers anticipate this formalizing the platform's role in book discovery.

items.title: Grammarly Discontinues AI Expert Review Amid Class-Action Lawsuit
items.summary: Grammarly is ending its AI 'Expert Review' feature that suggested edits using names of authors without permission. Journalist Julia Angwin filed a lawsuit against the parent company over the misuse. The feature pitched AI suggestions as advice from famous writers.

items.title: Grammarly's AI Impersonates Writers in 'Expert Review' Feature
items.summary: Grammarly's discontinued 'Expert Review' had AI cosplay as real writers for editing suggestions, including those from beyond the grave. The tool exemplifies AI writing aids overreaching in publishing. Backlash focuses on lack of permission and potential lawsuits.

items.title: Bookouture Signs Major Contracts for Mystery Series Expansions
items.summary: Bookouture announced new contracts for additional Sarah Vane Mysteries by Alice McCastle and a historical cosy crime series by Lydia Travers. The deals expand their commercial fiction portfolio. This reflects ongoing investments in popular genre series.

items.title: Oscars 'asphyxiated' viewers with wokeness leading to ratings decline
items.summary: A public relations specialist stated that the Academy has alienated half its audience through preachy woke celebrities and gloating social justice gestures at the 2026 Oscars. Viewers are switching off due to the heavy political slant. The ceremony's ratings have notably declined as a result.

items.title: Multiple speeches bleeped at 2026 Oscars for political content
items.summary: Several winners' acceptance speeches were censored live during the 2026 Academy Awards broadcast. Remarks on gun violence, politicians, Trump, and wars triggered the bleeps. The incidents fueled discussions on the role of politics in entertainment awards.

items.title: Michael B. Jordan wins Best Actor for 'Sinners' at 2026 Oscars
items.summary: Michael B. Jordan claimed his first Oscar for Best Actor, portraying dual roles in 'Sinners' directed by Ryan Coogler. He triumphed over competitors including Leonardo DiCaprio, Timothée Chalamet, and Ethan Hawke. The victory marks a career highlight and film success with multiple awards.

items.title: Justin Bieber and Usher altercation at Beyoncé-Jay-Z Oscars afterparty
items.summary: TMZ reported an intense altercation between Justin Bieber and Usher at an exclusive Oscars afterparty hosted by Beyoncé and Jay-Z. The news spread rapidly on X, prompting speculation about underlying tensions. The post amassed over 13k likes and millions of views.

items.title: KPOP DEMON HUNTERS performs 'Golden' at 2026 Oscars
items.summary: DiscussingFilm shared the full stage performance of 'Golden' by KPOP DEMON HUNTERS during the Oscars ceremony. The vibrant musical number stood out as a highlight of the evening. It linked to the complete winners list and garnered 77k likes.

items.title: Speculation erupts over Bieber-Usher Oscars afterparty fight
items.summary: User spicebae commented on the reported Bieber-Usher altercation at the Oscars afterparty, hinting at possible deeper reasons everyone is thinking about. The quote-tweet of PopCrave's report exploded with 67k likes and over 5 million views. It amplified audience buzz around celebrity conflicts post-Oscars.

items.title: Google Just Gave Small Businesses a Free AI Marketing Team
items.summary: Google has released a powerful free AI tool that functions as a complete marketing team for small businesses. By simply pasting in a website URL, it analyzes the brand and generates customized ads, social media posts, headlines, CTAs, and even animated video creatives. Now available in over 170 countries, this brand-matched tool represents one of Google's most significant free AI offerings for businesses.

items.title: Solopreneurs and Small Businesses Winning Big with Affordable AI Stacks
items.summary: The AI landscape has leveled the playing field, allowing solopreneurs to replicate the output of a 5-person team. Essential stacks cover customer support via chatbots like Tidio or ChatGPT, content creation with Claude or Jasper, and operations automation using Zapier and Notion. This setup costs under $100 per month while saving 10-15 hours weekly.

items.title: The Promptory Launches First Curated AI Marketplace with Built-In Strategy Advisor for Small Businesses
items.summary: The Promptory has debuted as the premier curated AI marketplace, featuring 101 vetted tools across 20 business categories like marketing and HR, plus a free AI advisor named Jordan for personalized strategies. Designed specifically for small businesses facing tool discovery challenges, it emphasizes quality over quantity with no paid listings. Vendor tiers start at $99/month, enabling practical AI adoption from business needs first.

items.title: Saifa AI Unveils Private AI Platform Tailored for SME Operations
items.summary: Saifa AI offers SMEs a private, company-specific AI platform trained on internal data such as documents, catalogs, and customer interactions to streamline knowledge management and workflows. It consolidates communication channels into one secure workspace, tackling high costs, complexity, and privacy issues that hinder small business AI adoption. The launch empowers SMEs with enterprise-grade capabilities at accessible levels.
